title: Last-mile vendor handoff and expense checklist
content:
Purpose:
Quick personal scratchpad for last-mile handoffs, vendor contacts, and expense reminders for the Q4 DevOps Summit booth (on-site lead notes). Use as a living checklist — copy into the team runbook when finalized.

Top priorities (by Thu noon):
- Confirm booth material dropoff window with Venue Logistics (see vendor notes).
- Print and attach return shipping labels for demo laptops (two labels: priority + backup).
- Cross-check card used for on-site purchases: Redwood P-Card ending 7342. If using personal card, flag reimbursement line items clearly.

On-site vendor & pickup contacts (call first, then text):
- Venue Logistics (main shipping desk): Jordan Park, VenueOps — +1 415-555-0122, jordan.park@bayvenue.com. Leave ETA and unwrap instructions.
- AV & Monitors: LumenAV / contact: Maria Gomez — +1 213-555-6677, mgr@lumenav.com. Confirm HDMI adapters and spare power strip.
- Booth Construction & Storage: BoltBuild — contact: Samir Ramesh, +1 206-555-0932. Request crate tags: RBW-2024-DEVOPS-01 and RBW-2024-DEVOPS-02.
- Catering handoff for VIP reception: Theo (Onsite Catering) — +1 415-555-9011. Confirm dietary notes: 2 GF, 1 Vegan.

Shipping / return logistics checklist:
- Pack list: demo laptop x2 (MacBook Pro 14), hotspot (T-Mobile Jetpack), demo cables (USB-C -> HDMI, USB-A), dongle kit, spare battery pack, 2 branded banners, 1 merchandise chest, 1 lockbox with receipts/cards.
- Pre-print outbound label for BoltBuild pickup (pickup window Fri 17:00-19:00).
- Return shipping: FedEx account 88-REDWOOD — schedule pickup for Sun 21:00 to avoid late fees.
- Crate tagging notes: label both short and long sides; include contents summary and "Fragile — Electronics" sticker.

Expense capture & reminders:
- Expense categories to use in Concur: travel.air, travel.lodging, travel.meals, events.booth, events.vendor-services, events-incidentals.
- If paying vendor in cash on site: take photo of receipt, note vendor name, date, and which POC accepted payment. Upload within 72 hrs.
- Personal card use: tag expenses with "personal-reimb" and include conference code EV-DEVOPS-Q4. Put line in notes: "Maya Lopez — booth supplies — submit for reimbursement".
- Per diem reminder: Redwood per diem for SF region = $70/day for meals (do not double-claim breakfast if included with hotel).
- Tips: round to nearest dollar on receipts, add handwritten memo on merchant receipt when possible (e.g., "merch stash — 50 pins").

Templates for quick entries (copy into Concur/Sheet):
- Example vendor payment entry: Date: 2024-10-18 | Vendor: BoltBuild | Amt: $420.00 | Category: events.booth | Payment: company-pcard | Receipt: boltbuild-inv-904.pdf | Note: crate assembly + storage (RBW-2024-DEVOPS-01).
- Example personal reimb: Date: 2024-10-19 | Vendor: FedEx Office | Amt: $32.85 | Category: events-incidentals | Payment: personal-visa | Receipt photo: IMG_20241019_1432.jpg | Note: labels + last-minute prints.

Booth staffing & shifts (on-site lead = Maya):
- Fri (setup): Maya 08:00-12:00 (on-site lead/setup) | Ethan 10:00-18:00 (AV + demos) | Priya 12:00-20:00 (booth ops + vendor sign-off).
- Sat (expo): Ethan 09:00-13:00 | Priya 13:00-17:00 | Maya 12:00-16:00 (lunch coverage 13:00-14:00).
- Sun (tear-down): Maya 16:00-21:30 (confirm crate pickup) | Fold-in volunteers: Alex (helper) 17:00-19:00.
- Shift rules: always handoffs in Slack #event-ops with time+status and photo of station. Capture one photo of receipts before closing day.

Emergency & incident notes:
- Lost item escalation: contact Venue Security desk (ext. 0) and open Slack incident thread; escalate to Event Ops lead (Ethan Cho).
- Card dispute flow: if unauthorized charge, notify finance@redwood.com and file ticket with Concur ref. Keep merchant receipt and bank statement screenshot.

Open questions / TODOs (quick):
- [ ] Confirm whether BoltBuild will pack foam inserts (I think yes but need confirmation).
- [ ] Print two extra blank receipts (for cash tips) and write merchant name + reason by hand.
- [ ] Clarify vendor tax invoices: do we need vendor VAT ID? (BoltBuild asked — send finance contact Priya).

Notes to self: keep receipts in two places: digital (phone camera -> receipts folder) and physical (lockbox). If handing receipts to finance rep in person, include tally sheet with totals per category.

Useful quick links (copy to mobile):
- Concur submit: https://expense.redwood.com/login
- Event runbook (team): https://confluence.redwood.com/display/EVENT/DevOps+Summit+Q4
- Vendor invoice portal: https://invoices.vendorco.com/987654

Versioning: this is my personal scratchpad — will consolidate with event runbook after Sunday.

End of scratchpad.
